artworks.title: Classical Landscape with a Fountain
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash over black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a landscape drawing from an elevated perspective. The scene depicts hills, a building on a hill with trees around it, two figures, a dog, and oxen near a circular trough. Fine brushstrokes detail the foliage and texture of the landscape. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and sepia. A large tree on the left frames the image, leading the eye towards the hills and the sky.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper, laid down on blue paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting multiple figures in various dynamic poses. The composition shows figures in motion, with some crouching, reaching or lifting, and one figure lying on a central platform. The scene conveys a sense of high activity or turmoil, with the figures positioned dynamically throughout. The use of lines and shading creates depth and a three-dimensional effect, enhancing the drama. The drawing uses a monochrome palette to emphasize form and action.

artworks.title: Lucretia
artworks.medium: watercolor heightened with white over black chalk
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 29.8 x 20.9 cm (11 3/4 x 8 1/4 in.)
overall: 86.3 cm (34 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Alice Kaplan

artworks.title: A Sacred Sheet Sent from Holy Mother Wisdom by Her Angel of Many Signs
artworks.medium: pen and blue ink
artworks.dimensions:
sight size: 43.2 x 34 cm (17 x 13 3/8 in.)
framed: 53.3 x 44.1 cm (21 x 17 3/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This drawing features an array of geometric shapes and intricate line patterns arranged in an abstract manner. At the center, there's a rectangular formation with a circular pattern inside. On either side of the central shape, there are additional circular designs divided into segments, with one on the right that looks like a sun. At the top and bottom of the drawing are several vertical and horizontal lines that connect to other circular and angular forms. These forms themselves are made up of small swirling lines that look almost like cursive letters of varying sizes. The lines and shapes are drawn in dark blue on off-white paper that appears slightly wrinkled.

artworks.title: Poor House, Hospital & Lunatick-Hospital of Northampton County, Pa.
artworks.medium: watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a bird's-eye view of a compound labeled as the "Poor House, Hospital & Lunatick-Hospital of Northampton County, Pa." The perspective shows rolling hills, mountains, and a pale blue sky with clouds. Central are well-structured brick buildings with blue roofs and smoke rising from chimneys. In the foreground, there are cattle, a horse, and trees in a fenced area. The painting features detailed architecture and a vivid rural environment with a rich color palette.

artworks.title: Mother's Banner of Love and Comfort
artworks.medium: pen and blue and red ink on paper mounted on cotton fabric
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image contains various geometric shapes such as triangles, diamonds, and ovals, with a central rectangular grid. The arrangement of these shapes and the text within and around them forms an abstract composition. The triangular shapes resemble peaks, while the grid in the center is reminiscent of a scoreboard or graph paper. The ovals at the bottom contain densely packed text. Small ornate tree-like forms are dispersed throughout the image.

artworks.title: The Cotters Saturday Night
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people sitting indoors at a wooden table in an L-shape. They vary in age and appearance. On the left, a woman in a bonnet and shawl sits next to a man in a blue jacket. Next to them, a woman in a yellow and white dress holds a book. A young boy with a red jacket and two young girls focus on an older man at the head of the table. The older man reads from a large book in front of a lit candle. The room has wooden beams, shelves with crockery, birds on rafters, and a cat on the floor.

artworks.title: A Fruit-Bearing Tree; A Cedar of Paradise
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with colored wash over graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a large central tree with dark green leaves and various red and purple fruits or flowers. The color palette includes dark greens, soft pinks, deep reds, and golds on a light cream background. There are large, colorful blooms in shades of red, pink, and yellow below the tree. Two golden fountains are at the base of the tree, and a decorative gold structure is to the right. A detailed script and small decorative elements in red and yellow cover the lower portion of the image.

artworks.title: Harpsichord Recital at Count Rumford's, Concord, New Hampshire
artworks.medium: transparent and opaque watercolor, pen and black ink, and graphite on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sight size: 18.7 x 26.3 cm (7 3/8 x 10 3/8 in.)
framed: 24.4 x 32 cm (9 5/8 x 12 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene. The room features elegantly dressed individuals around a harpsichord or piano, engaging with music sheets. The room is richly adorned with a brightly patterned carpet, pale green walls, oval and rectangular framed art pieces, decorative trim on the ceiling, and a fireplace on the left side. Portraits and small paintings adorn the fireplace.

artworks.title: To the Memory of George H. and Ruel T. Hills
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor, partly stenciled
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The painting captures a rural scene from an elevated perspective. The horizon is positioned towards the upper third of the image, showcasing rolling hills with trees extending into the distance. A tall tree with thick trunk and green leaves is at the center. There is a small lake with swans and a sailboat. Simple houses of warm colors are scattered across the landscape. The brushstrokes emphasize form and texture. The color palette includes earthy greens, browns, and soft pastel blue. The painting is framed with a decorative border.

artworks.title: The Ludlow Patton
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The painting depicts a river landscape with an elevated point of view, showing a bridge and city in the distance. The horizon is high in the composition, with a hazy skyline and a prominent dome visible. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, outlining trees, buildings, and boats. The color palette is soft with blues and greens, creating a serene ambiance. There are boats, figures, and a horse-drawn carriage near the river, leading to a bustling bridge. In the distance, a cityscape unfolds with various buildings. The sky is lightly clouded.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Burton Tremaine
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of an elderly man seated, facing forward with his head turned slightly to the right. He has a broad forehead, deep-set eyes, a small mustache, and a beard. His hair is covered by a flat cap. He is dressed in a formal jacket, shirt, and bow tie, with bold lines outlining his profile. The sketch is monochrome with shading for depth, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Les Champs-Elysées
artworks.medium: color lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Burton Tremaine

artworks.title: Queen of Hearts (Herzdame)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Burton Tremaine
artworks.description: The image displays intersecting lines and swirling curves creating an abstract composition. A central spiral resembles a stylized treble clef. Other lines intersect diagonally and horizontally, forming geometric shapes. Small leaf-like forms are present, evoking imagery of plants or organic growth. The overall effect is a blend of geometric precision and free-form, meandering lines, resembling a musical composition visually.

artworks.title: Cheval aile (Winged Horse)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Burton Tremaine
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse. The artwork shows a sketch-like image of a horse with an elongated neck and flowing mane. The horse is depicted with expressive lines that convey movement, and black shading adds contrast and depth. The background has a gradient from dark to light, emphasizing the dynamic pose and form of the horse within an abstract space. The overall composition is energetic and fluid.

artworks.title: Paul Cezanne
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Burton Tremaine
artworks.description: The image depicts a frontal drawing of a person with a slightly left inclination. The person has facial hair, a calm expression, visible eyes, and a high forehead. The hair is curly and sparse on top. They wear a dark, textured jacket that merges into a plain, light-colored background. There is no visible jewelry or objects held.

artworks.title: Evening (Le soir)
artworks.medium: 5-color lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Burton Tremaine
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with a view from an elevated point overlooking a harbor scene. The horizon is in the upper third, with distant ships under sails. A large pier or structure is on the right, textured with pointillist brushstrokes. The color palette includes pastel shades of pinks, blues, and yellows, capturing light on the water and sky. Small sailboats with colorful sails are close by, reflecting warm tones onto the water. The sea beyond is in cooler blues and greens. The brushstroke technique is characterized by small, systematic dots of color blending optically from afar. The scene conveys a harmonious balance of movement and light.

artworks.title: Game of Checkers (La partie de dames)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on China paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Burton Tremaine
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals and one person standing. All have their upper bodies visible. The person on the left is seated, facing the table, with a beard and short hair. The person on the right is also seated, leaned forward towards the table, showing a side profile and short hair. The standing person is leaning over the table, with one hand on their chin and hair up in a bun. Their facial expressions are not clearly defined. Both seated individuals wear dark, blended garments, while the standing person wears a patterned dress. The table has a checkerboard pattern. The room has a wall with ornate, floral wallpaper in the background.

artworks.title: Motherhood (Maternite)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on Japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Burton Tremaine
artworks.description: The image shows a round table with a textured cloth, a person holding a small child beside it under a shaded light. The color palette includes deep blues, browns, and muted creams with hints of red on the tablecloth. The person and child are seated to the right, partially in shadow, in a dimly lit room. Brown chairs are visible in the background against the walls, framing the scene.

artworks.title: River Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon in the upper third, marked by mountains. In the distance, a bridge crosses a body of water. Loose brushstrokes convey a spontaneous feel. Earthy tones dominate the color palette, giving an antique quality. A tree trunk and two figures are also present in the scene.

artworks.title: A Young and an Old Bacchant
artworks.artist: Marcantonio Raimondi, after Raphael or Giulio Romano
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting two mythological figures alongside a tree and a pedestal with sculpted heads. The figures are shown embracing, with the central figure supporting the other as they walk. The central figure has a beard and carries a cloak, while the younger figure holds a vine with grape clusters. A tree and a pedestal with sculpted heads are included, along with a barrel on the ground. The artwork has a classical aesthetic reminiscent of Renaissance art.

artworks.title: Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper with scraping, incised throughout, the verso blackened for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic scene within an architecturally-rich environment. The drawing shows entangled forms suggesting movement and struggle, set amidst classical architecture with columns and ruins. Figures in dynamic gestures are depicted in the detailed scene, set against a cityscape extending to rolling hills. The architectural features resemble ancient Roman or Greek styles, including ruins and a triumphal arch, highlighting a historical context. The drawing captures a dramatic moment of unrest.

artworks.title: A Landscape with Seated Soldiers and Fishermen
artworks.medium: black chalk with watercolor and white heightening on brown washed laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features a pastoral landscape with people engaging in leisure activities near a body of water. There is an elaborate stone structure with a relief, partially covered by a tree. In the distance, sailboats can be seen on the water. The brushstrokes are delicate, creating a tranquil ambiance. The color palette is soft and earthy, with browns, greens, and white accents. The scene conveys a serene afternoon by the shore.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Wooded Ravine
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray wash heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky woodland setting with trees, rocks, and foliage. The viewpoint appears to be from a lower vantage point looking upwards. The landscape is filled with trees and rocks blending with the sky, depicted through fine brushstrokes creating light and shadow. The color palette consists of earthy browns and grays. The scene includes weathered rocks in the foreground and complex, layered foliage in the background.
